frontier.hypothesis: RETAINED AS DOCUMENTATION ONLY (the 2026-08-30 disposition declares this space closed). frontier.mechanism: The sched1 pick rule is established (ready[0]; descending priority, ties by descending UID) and the dependence DAG plus LOG_LINKS are decoded and on disk from s18. What is missing is a faithful latency-queue / hazard-reordering model validated against the banked chassis traces.

frontier.hypothesis: RE-ACTIVATION TRIGGER (the only live one): a toolchain-model advance that can search the JOINT sched.c emission-order x global.c allocno-seat space closes CD_datasync and its two twins together.
frontier.mechanism: Every C change that fixes the emission order breaks the register seats and vice versa - proven across 19 sessions here and 59 on the twin CD_ready. The current solver suite (ra_solver, sched_solver) is single-axis, which is why both functions land on the same disposition.
frontier.next_probe: When a joint solver exists, re-open CD_datasync, CD_sync and CD_ready as one basin; the s19 dual-fork harness gives that campaign a 15x-cheaper scoring loop than the sandbox.
